{
  "version": "1.70.73",
  "updatedAt": "2026-08-31",
  "standards": [
    {
      "id": "ui.base-components.first",
      "title": "Base Components First",
      "value": "whenever building UI, use the shared primitives demonstrated on the Base Components page (/studio/base-components, pageKey base-components, catalog src/features/base-components/); do not invent custom base controls, raw HTML form inputs/checkboxes/textareas, or ad-hoc HeroUI markup when a catalogued section exists; match the living sample for that section (component, props, sizes, intents, chrome); Base Components is the visual source of truth — remaining projectStandards entries and topic shards are implementation detail for those primitives",
      "appliesTo": [
        "all new UI work",
        "forms",
        "dialogs",
        "toolbars",
        "grids",
        "buttons",
        "Base Components"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.heroui.no-custom-base-if-equivalent",
      "title": "No Custom Base Controls When Catalog Equivalent Exists",
      "value": "do not create custom base UI elements when Base Components already catalogs an equivalent section or shared wrapper",
      "appliesTo": [
        "input",
        "select",
        "checkbox",
        "textarea",
        "button",
        "modal",
        "Base Components"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.heroui.checkbox.use-uicheckbox",
      "title": "HeroUI Checkbox Standard",
      "value": "boolean toggles follow Base Components → Choice: use UiCheckbox (HeroUI Checkbox wrapper from shared/ui or components/ui/HeroFieldControls); never native HTML input type=checkbox",
      "appliesTo": [
        "checkbox",
        "boolean toggles",
        "multi-select lists",
        "filter toolbars",
        "form fields",
        "Base Components"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.heroui.radio.use-uiradiogroup",
      "title": "HeroUI Radio Standard",
      "value": "boxed multi-option checkbox/radio lists follow Base Components → Choice: UiCheckboxChoiceList / UiRadioChoiceList (src/shared/ui/FormChoiceFields.tsx); single rows use UiCheckboxChoice; low-level UiRadioGroup with layout=contents only when a custom host is required; option label typography via resolveUiChoiceOptionLabelClass / resolveUiRadioLabelClass; stacked choice rows use UI_CHOICE_STACK_GAP_CLASS (gap-1); exclusive title+description options use option cards (ui.form.choice.option-cards) not radio dots; do not hand-roll HeroUI Radio rows or per-page row className tuning",
      "appliesTo": [
        "radio",
        "radio groups",
        "form fields",
        "settings forms",
        "wizards",
        "Base Components"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.component.default-size",
      "title": "Default Form Control Size",
      "value": "match Base Components → Form fields group: sm is the default for form field controls (UiInput, UiSelect, UiTextarea, UiAutocomplete, UiCombobox, UiCheckbox, SemVerInput, UrlSegmentSlugInput, DesignerMaskInputField, DesignerDatePickerField); omit size or pass size=\"sm\"; prefer sm and md for routine forms, settings, modals, and toolbars — xs and lg are also supported (see src/shared/ui/heroFieldSize.ts) when a surface needs tighter or larger controls; size is not hard-limited to sm/md; use UiCombobox (HeroUI ComboBox) for typeable filterable pickers — not button-style UiAutocomplete; UiCombobox menuTrigger is focus (default, open list on focus), input (suggestions only after typing), or manual",
      "appliesTo": [
        "UiInput",
        "UiSelect",
        "UiTextarea",
        "UiAutocomplete",
        "UiCombobox",
        "UiCheckbox",
        "form fields",
        "settings forms",
        "create/edit modals",
        "Base Components"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.page-guide.hints",
      "title": "Page Guide Title And Hint On Explainable Controls",
      "value": "the studio page guide walks [data-page-guide] stops that have both title and hint; page content (toolbars, create, paging, dialogs, FormField/FormSection, designer, Data Studio) is first and shell header/sidebar chrome is last; skip Home nav and studio logo chrome; FormField hint, FormSection hint or description, FieldHintTooltip, Settings labelInfo, and PageHeaderToolbar description are auto-stops; AppButton intent=create, AppSplitButton intent=create, ToolbarSearchInput, ToolbarRefreshButton, ToolbarFilterRadioGroup, ToolbarFilterSelect, ToolbarFilterCheckbox, ToolbarFilterMatchLogicBadge, GridPagingFooter, and AppSearchBox are local page stops; generators and designer auto-CRUD must emit a plain-language hint on every generated field; sidebar trigger uses the Bot icon; click the companion to cycle body shapes; a CircleHelp control beside close in the bubble closes the tour and opens AppEndO chat and the companion leaves while the panel is open; the same CircleHelp beside close on the chat panel closes chat and restores the tour companion; drag it and release to hop it back under the bubble; the active hotspot stays visible and the bubble/companion do not cover it; bubble play/previous/next/done/close are ghost icon-only ICON_ACTION buttons with no visible labels; play shows a cyan circular countdown for the 8-second autoplay interval; hotspot dots swallow pointer events so the control underneath does not activate; do not invent filler hints on every existing field or unlabeled nav item; see docs/standards/ui-core.md §Page guide",
      "appliesTo": [
        "page guide",
        "FormField",
        "FormSection",
        "PageHeaderToolbar",
        "Component Designer",
        "auto CRUD",
        "generated UI"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.choice.boxed-list",
      "title": "Boxed Checkbox/Radio Choice Lists",
      "value": "multi-option checkbox or radio lists inside FormSection use UiCheckboxChoiceList / UiRadioChoiceList (src/shared/ui/FormChoiceFields.tsx) with resolveChoiceBoxShellClass chrome — no field label above the box; pair side-by-side with resolveFormFieldPairGridClass(true); exclusive title+description options use option cards (ui.form.choice.option-cards) instead; reference Sandbox Choice Behavior section",
      "appliesTo": [
        "checkbox",
        "radio",
        "UiCheckbox",
        "UiRadioGroup",
        "form fields",
        "FormSection"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.settings.feature-toggle.no-collapse",
      "title": "Settings Feature Toggles Stay Visible",
      "value": "Settings and config forms: boolean feature toggles (SettingsToggleField / UiCheckbox) must not hide dependent fields when off — keep sections visible and disable child controls via fieldset disabled={!enabled} with disabled:opacity-60 (or per-control disabled); nested toggles disable when the parent feature is off; do not conditionally unmount field groups on toggle; reference PwaSettingsSection.tsx and IdentityProviderFormModal.tsx",
      "appliesTo": [
        "settings forms",
        "SettingsToggleField",
        "config forms",
        "feature toggles",
        "SettingsFormGroup"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.flat-sections-no-boxes",
      "title": "Flat Form Sections (No Panel Boxes)",
      "value": "wizard, create/edit modal, and Settings config field grouping must use flat FormSection + FormField (src/shared/ui/FormSection.tsx) or SettingsFormGroup (src/features/settings/components/form/SettingsFormPrimitives.tsx): accent bar, uppercase section title tinted by tone, optional description and headerExtra, divided prop for top spacing (FORM_SECTION_DIVIDED_CLASS / pt-3) on every group after the first — no horizontal border lines between sections; intra-section field stack uses SETTINGS_FORM_GROUP_BODY_STACK_CLASS (space-y-2); Settings typography and subtle semantic color via getSettingsTypography(sectionId) in settingsSectionTypography.ts (page title, field labels, toggles, checkbox cards, grid lines) — content tints are darker than the Settings nav of the same hue (nav icons stay *-600; content uses *-900–*-950; do not darken submenu/selection); do not wrap form subsections in rounded-md border bg-white/slate panel boxes or per-row tinted cards — **exception:** boxed multi-choice checkbox/radio lists (UI_CHOICE_BOX_SHELL_CLASS in formChoiceLayout.ts), exclusive option-card boxes (SmtpEncryptionField) inside FormSection bodies, and read-only nested-editor inspector cards (docs/standards/ui-inspector-rail.md); AppSurfaceBox is for workspace/tool panels, not arbitrary wizard or settings form sections; bordered shells remain allowed for data hosts (grids, selection tables, AppTableGrid); reference UserCreateWizardModal.tsx, AuthSettingsFields.tsx, PackageBuilderModal.tsx, Sandbox form-fields, docs/standards/ui-core.md §Form field layout, docs/standards/ui-dialog.md",
      "appliesTo": [
        "step wizards",
        "create forms",
        "edit forms",
        "modal forms",
        "FormSection",
        "settings forms",
        "SettingsFormGroup"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-dialog"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.dialog.flex-growing-body",
      "title": "Create/Edit Modal Flex-Growing Body Host",
      "value": "when a create/edit modal body must stretch a checklist/grid/list to the footer, wire the full flex chain: shellClassName flex min-h-[min(<px>,72vh)] flex-col overflow-hidden (or size=maximized); bodyClassName flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col overflow-hidden !min-h-0; fixed bands shrink-0; growing section via FormSection className flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col; scroll only inside bordered data host (flex min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border + inner overflow-y-auto); do not use AppSurfaceBox fill inside CreateEditModalShell without this chain; do not duplicate section titles (AppSurfaceBox title + inner editor header); checkbox lists use flex flex-wrap gap-2 not fixed grid-cols-3; reference ConfigureDataApiDialog.tsx, docs/standards/ui-dialog.md",
      "appliesTo": [
        "CreateEditModalShell",
        "configure dialogs",
        "modal checklist hosts",
        "FormSection",
        "AppSurfaceBox fill"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-dialog"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.toolbar.filter-checkbox",
      "title": "Toolbar Filter Checkbox",
      "value": "single boolean filters in PAGE_TOOLBAR_FILTERS_CLUSTER_CLASS use ToolbarFilterCheckbox (or PAGE_TOOLBAR_FILTER_CHECKBOX_LABEL_CLASS): bordered h-8 label, w-auto content width, text-xs font-semibold, placed last after search/select; multi-option checkbox filters use PAGE_TOOLBAR_FILTER_CHECKBOX_GROUP_CLASS with ToolbarFilterCheckboxGroupItem (or PAGE_TOOLBAR_FILTER_CHECKBOX_ITEM_CLASS) per option — never full-row width; reference PackagesToolbar.tsx",
      "appliesTo": [
        "page toolbars",
        "grid toolbars",
        "filter toolbars",
        "ToolbarFilterCheckbox"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-toolbar"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.toolbar.builtin-filter",
      "title": "Toolbar BuiltIn Origin Filter",
      "value": "every list that filters platform vs operator items uses ToolbarBuiltInFilter (All default, BuiltIn, Not BuiltIn); do not mix BuiltIn into Kind, a hide-built-in checkbox, or a Hide/Show UiSelect; persist builtInFilter and migrate leftover showBuiltIn, hideBuiltinItems, hideBuiltinPortals, and Kind CSVs with migrateLegacyBuiltInFilter; reference Client Components, Server Functions, Libraries, Portals, Navigations",
      "appliesTo": [
        "page toolbars",
        "grid toolbars",
        "filter toolbars",
        "ToolbarBuiltInFilter",
        "built-in items"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-toolbar"
    },
    {
      "id": "component-designer.crud-set.filter-bar",
      "title": "CRUD Set Filter Bar Is Operator-Chosen",
      "value": "CRUD Set left toolbar is CrudSetSpec.filterBar: enabled defaults on (false hides the whole left cluster, including search and field filters); search defaults on (ToolbarSearchInput) when the bar is on; searchClear defaults on; 0..n field filters each have field, label, controlType (checkbox-group, radio-group, select), options, optional optionsFrom (static or distinct-rows from the current list), and checkbox matchLogic; array order is left-to-right after search; do not dump every column into the filter bar; chrome is Users (ToolbarFilterCheckboxGroupItem, ToolbarFilterRadioGroup, ToolbarFilterSelect, ToolbarFilterMatchLogicBadge); column-header filters stay on the grid; see docs/standards/crud-set.md",
      "appliesTo": [
        "CRUD Set",
        "filter bar",
        "page toolbar",
        "Users toolbar"
      ],
      "shard": "crud-set"
    },
    {
      "id": "component-designer.crud-set.edit-view",
      "title": "CRUD Set Edit And View Use RecordForm",
      "value": "CRUD Set create, form-patch, and view/delete-display bodies are RecordForm (Base Components Edit / View, palette heroui.record-form): main fields plus an optional docked side panel for formPlacement side (checkboxes, lock status) flush to header/footer/edge with equal 15px padding on the main column; default placement end (opposite theme direction); theme fill is --app-inspector-rail-bg (3.5% accent wash) and the splitter is ghost by default (WorkspaceVerticalSplitHandle appearance ghost); pin, show-title, title-in-header, and custom hex fill remain dialogs chrome; formControl and visibleWhen apply; View is read-only with no submit; patches use the Edit form; dialogs may name a designed Edit/View component; wrapping dialogs honor showHeader/showFooter; hand-written CRUD create/edit/view dialogs (Roles, Base Info, Org/Geo vocab) also render RecordForm — do not fork a parallel FormSection layout; configurators use CrudSetConfigCheckbox as a yes/no select (short label beside select); RecordForm booleans pass control=\"checkbox\"; do not wrap each field in a second section with the same title or repeat labels; boxed KV inspector cards stay nested-editor only; see docs/standards/crud-set.md and docs/standards/ui-inspector-rail.md",
      "appliesTo": [
        "CRUD Set",
        "RecordForm",
        "Edit / View",
        "Component Designer"
      ],
      "shard": "crud-set"
    },
    {
      "id": "component-designer.crud-set.refresh",
      "title": "CRUD Set Refresh Is Optional",
      "value": "CRUD Set Refresh is CrudSetSpec.refresh: default on shows ToolbarRefreshButton rightmost on the toolbar; false hides it; autoRefresh.enabled adds a checkbox next to Refresh (default off); omit the whole toolbar when filter bar, create, export, collection, auto-refresh, and refresh are all off (do not render an empty strip); the grid stays; see docs/standards/crud-set.md",
      "appliesTo": [
        "CRUD Set",
        "ToolbarRefreshButton",
        "page toolbar"
      ],
      "shard": "crud-set"
    },
    {
      "id": "auth.login.browser-password-manager",
      "title": "Login Form Lets The Browser Save Credentials",
      "value": "the sign-in form must be a real HTML login form so the browser password manager can save username/password: method=post action=/login (SPA still preventDefault + JSON /api/auth/login), named fields autocomplete=username and current-password, keep those inputs in the DOM through submit (hide not unmount during OTP), call navigator.credentials.store(PasswordCredential) after success with no in-page save-password checkbox; never write username/password to localStorage or sessionStorage; see docs/standards/dev-auth.md §Browser password manager",
      "appliesTo": [
        "login",
        "LoginPage",
        "UiInput",
        "UiPasswordInput",
        "password manager",
        "autocomplete"
      ],
      "shard": "dev-auth"
    }
  ],
  "matchCount": 16,
  "truncated": false,
  "maxRules": 20,
  "knowledgeKinds": [
    "STANDARD"
  ],
  "agentsMdPointer": "See AGENTS.md hub and docs/standards/INDEX.md for topic shards.",
  "runtimeApi": "/api/project-standards",
  "shardHint": "Pass shard (e.g. ui-grid) to load the full markdown topic file."
}
